bus_width_bits.title: Bus Width Bits
bus_width_bits.description: Logical payload width; independent of serialized physical data lanes

area_reference.description: Reference metals for area budgeting only; not a routed layer assignment

routing_layers.title: Routing Layers
routing_layers.description: Allowed metals by direction. Wires may be split across these layers. Omitted direction uses all matching enabled layers.

availability.title: Availability
availability.description: Per-layer usable fraction; overrides routing_availability. Zero disables automatic allocation.

shared_cores.title: Shared Cores
shared_cores.description: Cores served by one shared physical instance; core is its placement anchor, not a duplicate instance

utilization_basis.title: Utilization Basis
utilization_basis.description: Owner or evidence for target utilization; not a PDK rule

halo_um.title: Halo Um
halo_um.description: External placement clearance on every side, not internal whitespace

offset.title: Offset
offset.description: Fraction along edge; west/east from bottom, north/south from left

ReferenceGroup.title: ReferenceGroup
ReferenceGroup.description: Source estimates for a component or subsystem, never additive child costs.

core.title: Core
core.description: Optional owner core/tile used to select one of several TSV regions on the same interface

links.title: Links
links.description: Bound connections must remain on this die and traverse the corridor centerline
